sql.native_membership_rows:
CREATE TABLE native_membership_rows (
    member_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    key_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    row_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (member_kind, key_text)
)
sql.projects:
CREATE TABLE projects (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    merged_into TEXT,
    provisional TEXT,
    parent TEXT,
    tenant TEXT,
    folder INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    boundary INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    minted TEXT NOT NULL
)
